title: Implement Sieve of Eratosthenes in Go
description: Implement Sieve(n int) []int that returns all prime numbers up to n using the Sieve of Eratosthenes algorithm.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Sieve in sieve.go:
- If n < 2, return nil
- Create bool slice `composite` of size n+1
- For i from 2 while i*i <= n: if !composite[i], mark i*i, i*i+i, ... as composite
- Collect all i from 2 to n where !composite[i]
- Return the primes slice
All 4 test cases must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
